sentences.en: The divers needed decompression after their underwater adventure.
sentences.zh: 潜水员们在水下探险后需要进行减压。

sentences.en: During the flight, passengers had to go through a quick decompression check.
sentences.zh: 飞机上乘客必须接受快速的减压检查。

sentences.en: After spending time in the high-pressure chamber, he went into decompression for several hours.
sentences.zh: 他在高压舱内待了一段时间后，进行了几个小时的减压。
